meta.name: translate
meta.description: Translate English or Japanese tech articles into natural, fluent Chinese. Use whenever the user asks for Chinese translation, says "translate to Chinese" or "翻译", or provides English/Japanese content (pasted text or a file) to convert into Chinese. Chinese output only — not for translating into other languages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将英文或日文技术文章翻译成流畅中文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常读英文或日文技术文章，需要快速转为中文理解
copy.tagline_en: Translate English or Japanese tech articles into fluent Chinese
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often read English or Japanese tech articles and need quick Chinese understanding

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会将你提供的英文或日文技术文章翻译成自然流畅的中文，保留技术术语和产品名，不添加原文没有的内容。
howto.when: 当你要求翻译成中文、说“翻译”或“translate to Chinese”，或粘贴英文/日文内容时触发。

say.text: 把这段英文技术文章翻译成中文。
say.note: Claude 会执行直译、问题识别、意译优化三步后输出中文。

say.text: 翻译这个文件里的日文内容。
say.note: Claude 会先读取文件再翻译。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude translates English or Japanese tech articles into natural, fluent Chinese, preserving technical terms and product names without adding content not in the original.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for Chinese translation, say "translate to Chinese" or "翻译", or paste English/Japanese content.

say_en.text: Translate this English tech article into Chinese.
Translate the content of this file from Japanese.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file first then translate.
